headline: Iran Proposes 48-Hour Plan to Reopen Strait of Hormuz
summary: Iran has offered a 48-hour plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, as US President Donald Trump signaled progress in ongoing diplomatic talks.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is the world's most critical oil transit chokepoint, through which approximately one-fifth of global petroleum supplies flow.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: A potential reopening of the Strait of Hormuz removes supply interruption fears, easing crude prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

impacts.why: Global benchmark oil prices typically fall together when Middle East transit risks subside.
